batch.selection_metric: per-JD pairwise agreement with the run-11 score on the validation JDs (reference ties excluded, score tie 0.5); earlier grid point wins a tie (A3.6)

stop_rule.note: 06 §6 / A3.7: insufficient only if every rung fails; the batch is not extended either way

reference.grades: human raw labels: Good Fit=2, Potential Fit=1, No Fit=0 (D52); the LLM is never the reference

note: Per-JD nDCG and pairwise agreement as `evaluation.ordering`; 95% CI resampling JDs (10000). Verdicts: registration §3 on pairwise, yc, full (A3.8), LLM-dependent clause on llm_free; the mean-reference verdict beside. The run-11 judge saw Position; the rerankers read text_v2 (A3.1).

selection.note: Registration §5 as A3.9 reads it: walk SBERT weak < R3 < selected cross-encoder; a candidate failing O5 is skipped; otherwise it is adopted unless a dearer O5-passing candidate beats it with verdict `justified` (O1, O3, O4; yc, pairwise, full). If no reranker beats SBERT weak, stage 2 is SBERT weak ordering.

end_to_end.note: Relevant = final-set Fit among the 10 judged CVs per pool; the 490 distractors are unjudged and assumed not fits (upper-bound recall). Decides nothing (06 §4).

recall.system: extracted rule + TF-IDF -> R2 (selected cross-encoder, not adopted)
